A trained team that knows Tally inside out

Our experience with thousands of customers and over a decade with Tally shows in how we work. A team of well-trained, experienced service engineers is available to answer your queries online without delay.

With the help of Tally Solutions, we run monthly refreshers and regular internal training for our service engineers. The result is a strong service team with excellent Tally knowledge, whether the help is onsite or remote through remote communication software.

Tally support services we provide

What our team can do for you.

🧰

Installation and implementation

Different businesses need different Tally features. We deploy TallyPrime on your system and configure it to your requirements, so the right features are active before you start using it.

🔁

Data migration

Moving from an older version of Tally to a newer one? We guide the transfer so your data stays accurate and nothing important is lost.

🎓

Onsite training

Hands-on training for your staff on accounting, inventory, statutory compliance and payroll in Tally. We customise the programme to your needs, and sessions can be classroom-style and scheduled.

🔗

Data synchronization setup and support

If Tally is used in more than one location and data entered in one place must appear in the others, we set up and support synchronization between your offices, across geographies, using Tally.NET services or a static IP.

🧑‍🔧

Incidental support

Anything else that comes up, we are a call away. Our engineers can visit your site or help remotely.

How to contact us for Tally support

Pick whichever is easiest. We aim to get back to you quickly, often within an hour.
